title: PWA icons are plain amber squares (no logo/wordmark)
persona: New Android Chrome visitor wanting to install the PWA
expected: Branded app icon (e.g. sigma mark) on the Android home screen; maskable icon with logo inside the safe zone.
actual: All three icons are a solid amber square centred on #0A0A0A (maskable one just smaller). The installed app shows an anonymous block. Sizes (192/512/512), types, status 200, purpose any+maskable, colours #0A0A0A and display standalone are all valid.
